Actual late-index rebuild API backfills rows inside a migration transaction, retains allocation counter across another rebuild and supports coherent edits.
Buffered group deletion survives further native list activity from index maintenance and an ordinary audit callback; exact survivors/postings and stored audit identities are checked.
